subject.title: fix(gateway): add separate inline avatar size cap for agents.list projection

question: Should agent-list projection omit otherwise-valid local avatars above 256 KiB, or must this fix preserve their visibility through thumbnails or lazy dedicated-route references?
rationale: The PR intentionally changes visible behavior for existing valid avatar files, and source/tests cannot determine whether that compatibility tradeoff matches the intended client experience.

options.title: Accept bounded omission
options.body: Keep the 256 KiB projection cutoff, return no `avatarUrl` above it, and require client fallback plus upgrade proof.

options.title: Preserve avatar visibility
options.body: Pause this implementation and use bounded thumbnails or lazy authenticated avatar references so large configured avatars remain visible.

recommendation.title: Accept bounded omission
recommendation.body: Keep the 256 KiB projection cutoff, return no `avatarUrl` above it, and require client fallback plus upgrade proof.

likelyOwner.reason: Their recent merged change established the current projection and dedicated-route ownership boundary that this product choice modifies.
